beats.say: Megan Thee Stallion just sampled a 1999 Limp Bizkit hit, Billboard says.
The track "Thin Ice" uses the "Break Stuff" riff.
Billboard says it dropped Tuesday 20 October for her Tina Tuesday Freestyle series.
The video shows her in a bodysuit in a barren warehouse, Billboard notes.
A 1999 rock riff meets a 2026 rap freestyle in this track.
Rock samples in rap songs: yes or no?

facts: Megan Thee Stallion released Thin Ice on Tuesday October 20 as part of her Tina Tuesday Freestyle series.
The track Thin Ice samples Limp Bizkit’s Break Stuff from the 1999 album Significant Other.
The video shows Megan in a bodysuit bouncing around a barren warehouse.
